source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is export; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role is admin outside context internal; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80. Action approve in context internal prefers review at priority 70. Role operator or context sandbox prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk is TRUE or action is export; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.

Action approve in context internal prefers review at priority 70.
Role operator or context sandbox prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are deny, review, allow, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
